# Codemap - issue 81 (profile characteristic modifiers ignored in unit display)

One line per file the issue has to change or read as evidence. Reasons only; what changes inside a file is the researcher's call. Revised after increment 1, which proved the entry-id scope path correct end to end and narrowed the remaining work to condition scope resolution.

## The scope sweep (increment 2)

- `src/evaluator/query.js` - Resolves a condition's scope to a frame node (roster, force, parent, self, unit, ancestor, primary-catalogue, entry id, category id) and answers the count the condition compares against; it is where a scope can be left unresolved, and after increment 1 the only place a gated characteristic modifier can still be silently dropped.
- `src/evaluator/model.js` - Declares the ScopeKeyword and ScopeKind enumerations the closed scope list has to be reconciled against.
- `src/evaluator/modifiers.js` - Applies modifiers per node and per info carrier and gates them on their conditions and condition groups; the caller of the scope resolution above.
- `src/evaluator/catalogReader.js` - Reads modifiers, modifierGroups and their conditions out of the XML, including the scope attribute the closed list is about.
- `src/evaluator/countIndex.js` - Books nodes under their effective categories per frame; a scope resolves to a frame here, so a scope that resolves but counts nothing fails the same way as one that does not resolve.
- `src/evaluator/fixpoint.js` - Rebuilds the count index per round, which is what lets a condition gated on a dynamically added category hold at all; relevant to any scope whose gate depends on another modifier.
- `src/evaluator/query.unitScope.test.js` - Existing unit tests for scope="unit" resolution; the sweep extends or is measured against them.
- `src/evaluator/query.selfGatedInstanceOf.test.js` - Existing tests for instanceOf conditions gated on a self/entry-id scope, the shape increment 1 proved correct.
- `src/evaluator/modifiers.test.js` - Unit tests of the modifier layer including characteristic targets; a plausible home for gated-modifier cases per scope.
- `docs/battlescribe-data-format.md` - The canonical source for the closed list of scope values (7.6/7.7 and the scope boxes); it is corrected here if the list it documents proves incomplete.
- `src/parser/schema/Catalogue.xsd` - The upstream schema the closed scope list is derived against; read-only evidence.
- `docs/issues/81-profile-characteristic-modifiers-ignored-in-unit-display/issue.md` - Holds the record of which scope values cannot be covered from the catalogue data in the repository with the reason for each, and the record of what increment 1 established.
- `docs/testing/modifier-characteristic-value/README.md` - Declares instanceOf with scope="unit" on characteristic fields and non-numeric set values as deliberately uncovered by its E2E scenarios; read to see whether that statement still holds, but scenario authorship in this tree belongs to the e2e-testcase-author (ADR 0033).
- `src/components/editor/CLAUDE.md` - Suite doc written in increment 1; its guard-assert sentence is wider than the tests in that directory actually are.
- `package.json` - Version bump for a user-visible fix before the issue is merged, per the project's release rule; only if increment 2 lands one.

## Landed in increment 1 (kept as the regression pins this issue is judged by)

- `src/evaluator/evaluator.bloodlineProfileFixture.test.js` - Facade-level pin on the frozen fixture: Blood Dragon, Strigoi's non-numeric '5+', Necrarch's decrement, the no-bloodline control, and the separation of profile name from unit name.
- `src/components/editor/UnitSelectionCard.gatedProfileCharacteristics.test.jsx` - Component-level pin fed by a real evaluator report; the path the user actually sees.

## Read as evidence, not changed

- `src/evaluator/__fixtures__/whfb6-definitive/Vampire Counts (6th definitive edition).cat` and the accompanying .gst - Frozen fixture carrying the reported case (selectionEntry 6822-0110-a7c9-cbb0, infoLink a106-4a05-36ea-cb01, shared profile fabd-ef67-72f5-6b3f); read-only, never edited.
- `src/evaluator/effectiveState.js`, `src/evaluator/infoProjection.js`, `src/evaluator/report.js` - The write/read/assemble chain for characteristic values; increment 1 measured it correct for gated modifiers, so it is background unless the sweep finds a scope whose value is computed but not projected.
- `src/components/editor/UnitSelectionCard.jsx` - Renders the profile table from capability.infoElements verbatim; proved correct in increment 1.
- `src/components/play/PlayUnitDetails.jsx` and its evaluator test - Read the identical report field through the identical helper; proved to need no separate change.
- `src/evaluator/CLAUDE.md` - Suite doc governing the evaluator tests.

## Dropped from the map

- `src/__fixtures__/whfb6-lexicanum/vampire-selfscope-bloodline.cat.xml` - Increment 1 showed the frozen definitive fixture carries the case in full; the reduced excerpt is not needed.
- `src/evaluator/infoElements.test.js`, `src/evaluator/infoProjection.test.js` - The rule under test spans the whole chain and belongs at the facade, so neither file is a home for this issue's cases.

increments.title: Gated profile characteristic modifiers reach the unit profile display
increments.goal: A characteristic modifier whose condition holds for a unit changes the value the user sees in the unit profile table, for numeric and non-numeric values alike, with the reported Vampire Counts bloodline case as the worked example.
criteria: The unit profile display shows the modified characteristic value whenever a profile modifier's condition holds for that unit (issue AC 1).

With the frozen whfb6-definitive Vampire Counts fixture, a Vampire Count in a force that has chosen the Blood Dragon bloodline reports WS as the catalogue base value plus 2, and reports the Sv, Sv+ and A values the same modifierGroup sets (issue AC 2).
The same Vampire Count in a force without that bloodline still reports the unmodified base values (issue AC 3).
A non-numeric characteristic value written by a gated set modifier, such as an armour save 5+, reaches the display unchanged in form (issue AC 4).
The regression is pinned by a test that exercises the path the user actually sees - the evaluator report and the component fed by it - and not only the legacy profileCollector (issue AC 8).
The evaluator unit tests and the evaluator E2E suite pass, and no existing test is weakened or skipped to make the new ones green.
increments.note: Accepted with zero findings and no production diff. What it settled: for a condition whose scope is the unit's own selectionEntry id, the engine already applies gated characteristic modifiers correctly end to end - the report carries WS base+2, the non-numeric set values '4+' and '5+' arrive verbatim, and UnitSelectionCard renders them; the reviewer confirmed this through the app's own roster-construction and evaluation path, not only through a hand-built roster. Criteria 1-4 were therefore already satisfied and the deliverable was the regression pin (AC 8), now landed as src/evaluator/evaluator.bloodlineProfileFixture.test.js (5 cases) and src/components/editor/UnitSelectionCard.gatedProfileCharacteristics.test.jsx (2 cases), plus a new suite doc src/components/editor/CLAUDE.md. The reporter's symptom therefore does not live on the entry-id scope path, which makes the untested scope shapes of AC 5-7 the remaining candidate.

GOAL OF THIS INCREMENT (issue 81, increment 1): a gated profile characteristic modifier must reach the unit profile table the user sees, numeric and non-numeric alike, with the Vampire Counts bloodline case as the worked example (issue AC 1-4, 8).

=== MEASURED STATE OF THE CODE (read this first) ===
I ran two throwaway node probes (not the test suite) through the public evaluator facade against the frozen fixture `src/evaluator/__fixtures__/whfb6-definitive/` (gst + `Vampire Counts (6th definitive edition).cat`), with a roster `force e989-15b8-7eb6-9668 (Standard (VC-AB))` holding the Vampire Count `6822-0110-a7c9-cbb0` and, as a sibling, `Bloodlines a56a-eb32-5a45-16fd` with one bloodline child. The report's occupied slot `0/0` carries `infoElements` with these characteristics (profile entry id `a106-4a05-36ea-cb01`, name 'Vampire Count'):

| roster | WS | A | Sv | Sv+ | capability.name |
| no bloodline | 7 | 4 | 7 | 7 | Vampire Count |
| Blood Dragon 9fd9-e05c-ffcb-2c4d | 9 | 4 | 4+ | 7 | Vampire Count of Clan Blood Dragon |
| Strigoi ddfa-0d72-8557-6906 | 7 | 5 | 7 | 5+ | Vampire Count of Clan Strigoi |
| Necrarch 5017-296d-edef-4562 | 5 | 4 | 7 | 7 | Vampire Count of Clan Necrarch |

Same result with the single catalogue and with all 11 definitive catalogues loaded. So the engine already applies the gated modifiers correctly today, the non-numeric `set` values ('4+', '5+') already arrive verbatim, and the display component renders `characteristic.value` verbatim (`UnitSelectionCard.jsx` `renderProfileCell` -> `{c.value}`; `PlayUnitDetails.jsx:111-113` reads the same field). The reported symptom does not reproduce on the path the issue names.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE IMPLEMENTER: expect NO production change in this increment. The deliverable is the regression pin (issue AC 8) that makes this behaviour a fact the suite defends, at both observation points the AC names: the evaluator report and the component fed by it. Write no production code unless a pin the test-author wrote comes out red; then fix the engine, do not weaken the test.

=== WHY IT WORKS TODAY (the chain, so a red pin can be diagnosed without re-deriving it) ===
The catalogue shape (fixture, `selectionEntry 6822-0110-a7c9-cbb0`, offset ~210237):
- `infoLink a106-4a05-36ea-cb01` -> shared profile `fabd-ef67-72f5-6b3f` carries ONE `modifierGroup type="and"` with five members, each gated by `condition type="instanceOf" field="selections" scope="6822-0110-a7c9-cbb0" childId=<bloodline category> shared="true" includeChildSelections="true"`:
  * `set value="4+" field=f1be-e66c-d5e1-673c (Sv)` gated on category `4cae-a20e-8374-b6cb` (Blood Dragon)
  * `increment value="2" field=f95b-da01-0578-3bdc (WS)` gated on `4cae` (Blood Dragon)
  * `decrement value="2" field=f95b (WS)` gated on `fc4b-a86d-5897-9e4c` (Necrarch)
  * `set value="5+" field=d4a9-0ed4-d041-e54b (Sv+)` gated on `bf30-4ff0-a4d8-3909` (Strigoi)
  * `increment value="1" field=6b9f-c8fe-8998-27e3 (A)` gated on `bf30` (Strigoi)
  READ THIS CAREFULLY: under Blood Dragon only WS and Sv change; Sv+ and A are Strigoi-gated and keep their base values 7 and 4. Any expectation that Blood Dragon yields Sv+ 5+ or A 5 is a misreading of the data.
- The unit's own `modifierGroups` (BLOODLINE bracket, five sibling groups) each carry `modifier type="add" value=<bloodline category> field="category"` plus an `append` on `name`, gated by `condition type="atLeast" value="1" field="selections" scope="force" childId=<bloodline upgrade id> shared="true" includeChildSelections="true"`. The category therefore exists only after the force-wide bloodline choice.

The engine chain, layer by layer:
1. `fixpoint.js` `evaluateToFixpoint` rebuilds the count index from the effective state each round (MAX_FIXPOINT_ROUNDS = 5). Round 1 adds category `4cae` to the unit node; round 2's index sees it. This two-round dependency is what makes the gate work at all.
2. `countIndex.js` `targetsOf` books a node under `effective.categoryIdsOf(node)`, so the unit counts under `4cae` in its own frame (BASE bucket).
3. `query.js` `resolveFrame` -> `resolveSharedFrame` default branch -> `nearestAncestorWithDefId(node, '6822-0110-a7c9-cbb0')` resolves the entry-id scope to the unit node itself; `index.get(scopeKey(frame,'4cae'), includeChildSelections=true, false, true, includeFrameOwn = (frame===ctx.node))` returns 1; `COMPARATORS[instanceOf] = actual > 0` holds (the condition's `value="0"` is correctly ignored for membership types).
4. `modifiers.js` `applyCarrierModifiers` runs the infoLink's `modifierGroups` with `carrier = the infoLink`; `MODIFIER_HANDLERS[SET][CHARACTERISTIC]` is `textSetHandler` (deliberately a TEXT setter, which is why '4+'/'5+' survive), `INCREMENT`/`DECREMENT` are `numericHandler(..., asText)`.
5. `effectiveState.js` writes the override under the key pair (node, carrier=infoLink); `characteristicEntriesOf(node, carrier)` reads the base list through `baseCharacteristicsOf`, which falls back to `carrier.resolved.characteristics` (the shared profile). Writer and reader use the same carrier - that pairing is the load-bearing part.
6. `infoProjection.js` `buildProfileEntry` turns that into `{ typeId, name, value }` triples; `report.js` puts them on `capability.infoElements`.
7. App side: `evaluationCache.evaluateAppRoster` -> `rosterAdapter.toEvaluatorRoster` (defId = `entryLinkId ?? selectionEntryId`; the Vampire Count has no entryLink anywhere in the catalogue, so its defId is the entry id and the entry-id scope resolves) -> `UnitSelectionCard.jsx:182-198` reads `capabilities.get(pathBySelectionId.get(selection.id)).infoElements`, filters `kind === 'profile'`, groups via `groupProfilesByType` (`src/roster/rulesEvaluator.js`, groups by `profileTypeName`, does not touch values) and renders `{c.value}` in `renderProfileCell`.

IF A PIN COMES OUT RED, diagnose in this order: (a) does the report show the modified value at all (evaluator-level pin red too) or only the component (then the fault is in the component/adapter seam); (b) is category `4cae` on the unit's effective categories (fixpoint round 2 / `targetsOf`); (c) does the entry-id scope resolve (`nearestAncestorWithDefId`, would emit an `unresolvedScope` diagnostic); (d) do writer and reader agree on the carrier (`effectiveState` key pair).

=== EXPLICITLY NOT IN THIS INCREMENT ===
- The scope sweep (issue AC 5-7: `scope="unit"`, the closed scope list from the format doc and the XSD, the uncoverable-scope record in issue.md) - a later increment.
- `docs/testing/modifier-characteristic-value/README.md` and any `docs/testing/` scenario: E2E scenario authorship is delegated to the `e2e-testcase-author` agent (ADR 0033, root CLAUDE.md). Do not edit that tree here.
- `SelectionConfigurator.jsx:96-104`, `upgradeDetails.jsx:62-93`, `UnitChips.jsx:41` - the issue declares these separate display paths out of scope.
- The legacy `src/roster/profileCollector.js` and its tests - not touched, not deleted, not weakened.
- No version bump in `package.json`: this increment adds tests only and changes nothing a user can see.
- Cosmetic: the report's characteristic entries carry no `originalValue`, so `getModificationState` never marks a modified cell as changed and no tooltip breakdown appears. That is a display nicety outside every criterion of this increment - do not implement it, and do not assert on cell CSS classes.

WHETHER: tests, yes - they are the whole deliverable of this increment (issue AC 8).

WHAT I RAN, AND WHAT I DID NOT: I ran no test suite and took no baseline; nothing here is a claim about which tests are currently green or red. I did run two throwaway node scripts (deleted again) that called the public facade `prepareDataset`/`evaluate` on the frozen fixture, because the whole increment turns on whether the reported case still fails - it does not. The measured values are in `plan` and are the source of the expectations below. Whoever runs the commands below runs them first.

CONVENTIONS: `src/evaluator/CLAUDE.md` is the suite doc for the evaluator test file - load it and follow it (German `describe`/`it` titles, `globalThis.DOMParser = new JSDOM().window.DOMParser` at module top, drive only the public facade `prepareDataset` + `evaluate`, assert against `report.capabilities`, nothing mocked, memoise the fixture parse across the file's cases, mark a case that pins already-correct behaviour with `KONTROLLE:` in its title). Nothing I read contradicts it. There is NO suite doc for `src/components/editor/` (no `CLAUDE.md` anywhere under `src/components/`): write a short one as part of your step, describing the conventions the directory already follows and that the new file follows - vitest + @testing-library/react `render`, `vi.mock` for `lucide-react`, `./BottomSheet` and the child components that have their own tests, real fixtures loaded in `beforeAll` through the production seam (`processImportedData` + `prepareDataset`/`evaluate` + `toEvaluatorRoster`), German test titles, naming `<Component>.<topic>.test.jsx`, and the single-file run command.

WHAT - CASE 1 (issue AC 2, 3, 4): evaluator report on the frozen fixture.
File: `src/evaluator/evaluator.bloodlineProfileFixture.test.js` (new). Level: facade/integration. Framework: vitest. Run: `npx vitest run src/evaluator/evaluator.bloodlineProfileFixture.test.js`.
Dataset: `prepareDataset({ gameSystem: <'Warhammer Fantasy Battles (6th definitive edition).gst'>, catalogues: [<'Vampire Counts (6th definitive edition).cat'>] })` from `src/evaluator/__fixtures__/whfb6-definitive/`, parsed ONCE for the file.
Roster per case: `{ forces: [{ defId: 'e989-15b8-7eb6-9668', count: 1, children: [ { defId: '6822-0110-a7c9-cbb0', count: 1, children: [] }, <bloodline block> ] }] }` where `<bloodline block>` is `{ defId: 'a56a-eb32-5a45-16fd', count: 1, children: [{ defId: <bloodline id>, count: 1, children: [] }] }` and is omitted for the no-bloodline case.
Observation point: the capability whose `defId === '6822-0110-a7c9-cbb0'` and `anchorKind === 'occupied'` (slot path `0/0`), its `infoElements` entry with `kind === 'profile'` and `id === 'a106-4a05-36ea-cb01'`, read by characteristic NAME ('WS', 'A', 'Sv', 'Sv+').
Derive the base values from the raw fixture XML inside the test file (the file's own `new DOMParser().parseFromString(...)`, as `evaluator.corpusLinkLocalChildren.test.js` does): the `<profile id="fabd-ef67-72f5-6b3f">` characteristics, keyed by `typeId` - WS `f95b-da01-0578-3bdc`, A `6b9f-c8fe-8998-27e3`, Sv `f1be-e66c-d5e1-673c`, Sv+ `d4a9-0ed4-d041-e54b`. Let no DOM element survive into module scope; keep only the derived plain values. Today those base values are WS 7, A 4, Sv 7, Sv+ 7, but assert against the derived numbers, not against literals, wherever the AC speaks of the base value.
Cases:
  1a KONTROLLE (AC 3) - roster WITHOUT any bloodline: WS, A, Sv, Sv+ all equal their derived base values.
  1b (AC 2, AC 4) - bloodline `9fd9-e05c-ffcb-2c4d` (Blood Dragon): WS equals base WS + 2 (i.e. 9); Sv equals the literal string '4+' (the `value` of the gated `set`, non-numeric, unchanged in form); Sv+ and A stay at their base values (7 and 4) because those two members of the same modifierGroup are gated on the Strigoi category, not on Blood Dragon. Assert all four in one case - the point is that the group discriminates.
  1c (AC 4, the '5+' armour save the criterion names) - bloodline `ddfa-0d72-8557-6906` (Strigoi): Sv+ equals the literal string '5+'; A equals base A + 1 (i.e. 5); WS and Sv stay at their base values.
  1d (edge, the opposite arithmetic sign) - bloodline `5017-296d-edef-4562` (Necrarch): WS equals base WS - 2 (i.e. 5); A, Sv, Sv+ stay at their base values.
  1e (edge, exclusivity) - in case 1b assert additionally that the profile ENTRY name is still 'Vampire Count' while `capability.name` is 'Vampire Count of Clan Blood Dragon': the `append` on the unit's name must not leak into the profile row, and the profile row's own name must not swallow the unit name.
Assert values as strings exactly as the report carries them ('9', '4+', '5+'); do not coerce to numbers except where the AC states an arithmetic relation, and then compare `Number(effective) === Number(base) + 2`.

WHAT - CASE 2 (issue AC 1, AC 4, AC 8): the component fed by that report.
File: `src/components/editor/UnitSelectionCard.gatedProfileCharacteristics.test.jsx` (new). Level: component. Framework: vitest + @testing-library/react. Run: `npx vitest run src/components/editor/UnitSelectionCard.gatedProfileCharacteristics.test.jsx`.
Build it from the two existing patterns: the props and mocks of `src/components/editor/UnitSelectionCard.evaluator.test.jsx` (mock `lucide-react`, `./BottomSheet`, `./SelectionConfigurator`, `./UnitChips`; the card gets `capabilities` and `pathBySelectionId` as props already), and the real-fixture seam of `src/components/editor/SelectionConfigurator.groupMembership.test.jsx` (`processImportedData([{name,content}] gst, [{name,content}] cat).system` plus `prepareDataset` on the same two XML strings, both in `beforeAll`).
App roster: hand-built, in the shape `rosterAdapter` reads - `{ catalogueId: <the .cat root id '4d73-5ab0-9020-403c'>, name, costLimit: 3000, costLimitType: 'ecfa-8486-4f6c-c249', forces: [{ id: 'force-1', forceEntryId: 'e989-15b8-7eb6-9668', catalogueId, selections: [ <VC>, <bloodline> ] }] }` with `<VC> = { id: 'sel-vc', name: 'Vampire Count', entryLinkId: null, selectionEntryId: '6822-0110-a7c9-cbb0', number: 1, category: null, selections: [] }` and `<bloodline> = { id: 'sel-bloodlines', name: 'Bloodlines', entryLinkId: null, selectionEntryId: 'a56a-eb32-5a45-16fd', number: 1, category: null, selections: [ { id: 'sel-bd', name: 'Bloodline of Clan Blood Dragon', entryLinkId: null, selectionEntryId: '9fd9-e05c-ffcb-2c4d', number: 1, category: null, selections: [] } ] }`. Feed it through `toEvaluatorRoster` -> `evaluate(prepared, evalRoster)` and render the card for the `sel-vc` selection.
Cases:
  2a (AC 1, AC 2, AC 4) - with the Blood Dragon selection present: guard-assert first against the real report that the slot's profile entry carries WS '9' and Sv '4+' (the same guard style the existing evaluator card test uses), then assert the rendered `.profile-table`: the header row contains 'WS' and 'Sv', and the cell under 'WS' reads '9' and the cell under 'Sv' reads '4+'. Match cell to header by column index within the model stat-block table, not by scanning all cell texts - '9' also occurs as the Ld value and a bare `toContain('9')` would pass on the wrong cell.
  2b KONTROLLE (AC 3) - the same roster without the bloodline selections: the same cells read '7' and '7'.

That leaves inc-2, now the whole of the issue and the only place the reporter's symptom can still live inside its boundary: the closed scope list from the format doc and the XSD, no scope silently dropped on a characteristic modifier, and every scope covered or recorded as uncoverable. I sharpened inc-2 with two things increment 1 produced - the issue file must also record what increment 1 established, and the suite doc src/components/editor/CLAUDE.md overstates the guard-assert convention - and rewrote the codemap around scope resolution, dropping the files increment 1 proved untouched.
